en.headline: 39 fall ill after school lunch in Sha Tin; supplier ordered to suspend
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a suspected food-poisoning cluster at Baptist (Sha Tin Wai) Lui Ming Choi Primary School after pupils and staff ate soy-braised chicken drumsticks and penne on Wednesday.
body: The Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health said on Saturday it was investigating a suspected food-poisoning cluster involving 39 people at a primary school in Sha Tin.

The cases involved 37 students — 23 boys and 14 girls aged five to 11 — and two school staff members aged 34 and 38. They developed abdominal pain and diarrhoea about eight to 22 hours after eating a catered lunch provided by a supplier at the school on 9 September.
Two of the affected pupils sought medical care but did not require hospital admission and remained in stable condition. The others had mild symptoms and did not see a doctor.

Initial findings indicated that those who fell ill had eaten the same style of school lunch beforehand, pointing to a likely food-poisoning link with the supplier’s soy-braised chicken drumsticks and long tubular pasta.

Officers from the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department and the Centre for Health Protection inspected the school’s food storage, serving arrangements and environmental hygiene, took samples for laboratory testing and advised the school on prevention measures. FEHD staff also inspected the lunch supplier’s premises.

The Centre for Food Safety ordered the supplier to stop providing the implicated dishes, suspend operations on Saturday for thorough cleaning and disinfection, train staff on food safety and environmental hygiene, and submit food and environmental samples for testing.

zh.headline: 沙田小學39師生疑食物中毒 午膳供應商須暫停運作
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心調查浸信會沙田圍呂明才小學懷疑食物中毒群組，37名學生及兩名職員進食供應商提供的滷水雞髀及長通粉後腹痛腹瀉。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心周六表示，正調查一宗涉及39人的懷疑食物中毒個案群組，事涉沙田一所小學。
個案涉及37名學生，包括23男14女，年齡介乎5至11歲，以及兩名分別34歲及38歲的學校職員。他們於9月9日在校內進食由供應商提供的午膳，約8至22小時後出現腹痛及腹瀉。
其中兩名受影響學生曾經求醫，毋須入院，情況穩定；其餘人士病徵輕微，毋須求醫。
初步調查顯示，受影響人士發病前曾於校內進食同款式午膳，較大機會涉及食物中毒，可能與供應商提供的滷水雞髀和長通粉有關。
食環署及衞生防護中心人員已到該校視察，檢視食物儲存及分配流程和環境衞生，抽取食物樣本作化驗，並向學校提供預防建議。食環署人員亦到涉事午膳供應商巡查。
食物安全中心已指示有關供應商暫停供應涉事食物，於周六暫停運作進行徹底清潔消毒，向員工提供食物安全及環境衞生教育，並抽取食物及環境樣本作化驗。
